ios.desc:
**Stay off your phone and a tree grows. Leave early and it withers. That's Forest, the focus timer used by 60 million people worldwide.**

Top productivity app in 136 countries. Recommended by The New York Times and Business Insider.

"Forest works well, and if your goal is to be more in the moment, ignore your phone and actually talk to your friends when you are with them, this is the app for you." — The New York Times

Together, our community has planted over 2 million real trees on Earth through our partnership with Trees for the Future.

---

STAY FOCUSED

Forest helps you overcome phone addiction, reduce distractions, and build deep work habits. Whether you are studying for exams, working from home, or simply trying to be more present, Forest gives you a reason to stay on task.

- A gamified focus timer that turns screen-free time into a growing virtual forest
- Create personalized Allow Lists to block distracting apps during focus sessions (iOS 16 or above)
- Track your daily phone usage and screen time

GET MOTIVATED

- Unlock tree species and soundscapes as you reach focus milestones
- Co-plant trees with friends and family during shared focus sessions
- Compete with users around the world and share your forest
- Unlock achievements and earn extra rewards
- Plant real trees on Earth through our partnership with Trees for the Future

TIME GUARD: BLOCK DISTRACTIONS ON SCHEDULE

Time Guard helps you set phone-free windows throughout your day. Block distracting apps on a schedule, limit when you can access them, and track how much time you spend on your phone.

MINDFUL SPACE: RESET YOUR MIND

Mindful Space combines calming soundscapes, breathing exercises, and gentle animations to help you decompress between focus sessions. 

STATISTICS & INSIGHTS

- Create custom tags and view detailed statistics of how you spend your focused time
- Review your weekly, monthly, and yearly focus history as a visual forest
- Revisit your focus journey with Forest Timeline
- Sync your focused time with Apple Health

It is never too late to build better habits.

---

FOREST PLUS

Love Forest? Try Forest Plus.

- 3x coin rewards and unlock new trees faster
- Exclusive Plus-only tree species and early access to seasonal new trees
- Turn your focus into a real tree on Earth

Start your free trial today, cancel anytime.

---

NOTICE

Forest is available on iPhone and iPad. Sign in with the same account to sync your data and access Forest Plus across all platforms.

As you stay dedicated to your tasks, this interactive study timer grows a thriving tree. But if you give in to the temptation of scrolling social media, your cute little tree will wither.

quotes.text:
There are various apps to try and promote healthy levels of smartphone  engagement. Eg in Forest (iOS and Android, no affiliation)[0] you plant a tree and it will grow with time, but will wither away the more you play with Facebook. It will occasionally notify in case you get lost in facebooklandia.

If you object to that particular implementation, the point is there's a usage API in case you'd like to write your own app.

[0] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=cc.forestapp

I recommend the Forest app. It works on both desktop and mobile and allows you to block sites as well as apps and sync your preferences between accounts. I will usually set a 2 hour timer while I need to focus.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/forest-stay-focused/id866450515
https://www.forestapp.cc/

I've been using the StayFocusd [1] extension in Chrome, which gives you a daily allowance on sites you list.

... but then I found myself using Safari to get around that allowance.

There's also Forest [2], which "gamifies" staying away from websites for a certain time. It's the Chrome extension version of the Forest iOS app [3] to stay away from your phone.

I like to think of StayFocusd as the stick, and Forest as the carrot.

[1] https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/stayfocusd/laankejkbhbdhmipfmgcngdelahlfoji?hl=en

[2] https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/forest-stay-focused-be-pr/kjacjjdnoddnpbbcjilcajfhhbdhkpgk?hl=en

[3] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/forest-stay-focused/id866450515
